description_en: This API is used to manage the connection address and port of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于管理实例的连接地址和端口
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-connection-string --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --current-connection-string rm-uf6wjk5x0000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --connection-string-prefix rm-0000 --port 3306 --babelfish-port 1433 --general-group-name rgc-bp1tkv80000 --pg-bouncer-port 6432 --target-db-instance-id pgm-bp1206s14p3o0000 --retain-vip false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint of the instance. It can be an internal endpoint, a public endpoint, or a classic network endpoint in hybrid access mode.

The read/write splitting endpoint cannot be changed
parameters.help_zh:
实例当前的某个连接地址，可以是内外网连接地址，或者混访模式下的经典网络连接地址。
不支持修改读写分离连接地址
parameters.name: current_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the endpoint after the change. Only the prefix of the value of CurrentConnectionString can be changed.

The value must be 8 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The value cannot contain any of the following special characters: ! # % ^ & * = + | {} ; : ' " ,<> / ?
parameters.help_zh:
目标连接地址的前缀，即只能修改CurrentConnectionString参数的前缀部分。
长度8~64，不能包含汉字和非法字符（~!#%^&*=+\|{};:'",<>/?），建议由字母、数字、短横线（-）组成
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The port number after the change
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The Tabular Data Stream (TDS) port of the instance for which Babelfish is enabled.

This parameter applies only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.help_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.name: babelfish_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated cluster to which the instance belongs. This parameter is returned only when the instance is created in an ApsaraDB MyBase cluster that runs MySQL on Standard Edition
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The PgBouncer port.

This parameter is suitable only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. If you enable PgBouncer for your instance, you can change the PgBouncer port of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
PgBouncer端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，如果开启了PgBouncer，则支持修改PgBouncer端口号
parameters.name: pg_bouncer_port

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target RDS PostgreSQL instance whose connection address you want to swap with the current instance.  

This parameter is supported only for RDS PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
需要交换连接地址的目标RDS PostgreSQL实例ID。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the virtual IP address (VIP) when swapping connection addresses.  

true: Retains the VIP.  
false (default): Does not retain the VIP.  

This parameter is supported only for RDS PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
交换连接地址时是否保留虚拟IP地址（VIP）。

true：保留VIP。
false（默认值）：不保留VIP。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: retain_vip
